summary: Crane activity near London may cause fluctuating readings on the London navigation beacon's 155 to 195 degree magnetic radials.
text:
VOR/DME LON/LONDON 113.60MHZ CH083X - THERE MAY BE OBSERVATIONS OF
DVOR BEARING FLUCTUATIONS WITHIN THE 155 195 DEG. MAG. SECTOR
RADIALS FROM THE LONDON VOR/DME STATION, DUE TO CRANE ACTIVITYIN
